title: Bhanugupta
hook: Bhanugupta: Eran abhilekh aur sati ka praman

facts.Pehchan: Eran abhilekh aur sati ka praman

exam_points: Eran abhilekh (510 CE): Goparaja ki mrityu aur uski patni ke sati hone ka sabse purana abhilekhiya praman mana jata hai.

mcqs.q: Sati ka sabse purana abhilekhiya praman kis abhilekh mein mana jata hai?
